name: ChEBI (Chemical Entities of Biological Interest)
goodFor: Names, definitions, structures and classes of small molecules that matter in biology.
attribution: "ChEBI" and the entry's ID (CHEBI:<number>), linked to the entry's page on www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi; "CC BY 4.0", linked to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; and a note when what's shown was changed.

notes: Checked against ChEBI's About page and EMBL-EBI's Terms of Use (last revised 14 October 2026). ChEBI's data are CC BY 4.0, and EMBL-EBI's terms add no restriction beyond the data owners' own, so commercial use is allowed and a paid app may show an entry's name, definition or structure with the credit in attribution. EMBL-EBI expects credit in products too, which the attribution covers; ChEBI also asks that publications cite its paper. Each data item names its original source, which may hold rights of its own; EMBL-EBI leaves that to the user. Heavy automated use gets a client blocked, so an app shouldn't query ChEBI from every student's device. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
